1. 论文措辞避免 "Detach BN > Vanilla"，改为 "Detach BN ≈ Vanilla (statistically indistinguishable)"，支持 "detach 消除损害" 而非 "detach 带来好处"
2. Binomial test 重新表述：Gradient ON 条件 ≤ Vanilla (几/几), Gradient OFF ≈ Vanilla
